conflicts.detail: CON-0232 defines how an empty implementer output is handled, either as a failed attempt or as a trigger for S2. CON-0124 governs the passed transition of a task through the requirement that tests exist. It is not stated whether an empty output can ever reach the CON-0124 gate, or whether it fails before the gate and counts as an attempt in its stage. Without that, the attempt count and the gate result can disagree.

resolution.reason: files: [] ist kein Fehlversuch, sondern läuft durch das GREEN-Gate (CON-0232 INV-03); der passed-Übergang aus CON-0124 betrifft den Legacy-Pfad.

conflicts.detail: CON-0061 (tdd-cycle-enforcement) defines the red/green cycle and how it is repeated. CON-0232 introduces attempts per stage and an S2 trigger based on them. The two contracts can count retries differently: a TDD repeat versus a stage attempt. It is not specified which counter controls escalation to S2.

resolution.reason: Die Stufenzähler ändern nur, wann S2 kommt; RED vor GREEN bleibt durch die Pipeline-Gates erzwungen.
